title: Better document drafting and improved search
summary: Choose how long a draft should be, ask for highlights, keep tables in house style, and find past threads by what they cover, not just their title.
body_markdown:
A run of changes that bring drafts back closer to what you asked for.


## The right length


Parachute now asks before it starts drafting: brief, standard or comprehensive. Pick one and the draft comes back at that length.


## Highlights and tables


- Ask Parachute to highlight a clause in any colour the editor offers. Ask again to change the colour or remove it.
- New table rows and columns pick up the formatting around them, including shading, borders, numbering and fonts.


## Threads in and out


- Drag a whole folder onto the chat box and Parachute picks up the files inside. One button clears them all.
- Download a full thread as a Word document, citations included, from the thread header.


## Find your work faster


- A dedicated search page finds threads by what they cover, not just their titles.
- Create a matter straight from the matter picker, without leaving what you’re doing.


## Closer checks


- Parachute checks the legislation sections it cites, not just the Act.
- Parachute reads the comments in a document when it works on it, so your notes to self shape the result.
